ChangeNotes.Value: v1.5.0 - Added DeepSeek and Gemini as built-in backends. DeepSeek is the cheapest paid option; Gemini has a real free tier (no card, ~1,500 replies a day) - two catches: Google trains on free-tier traffic, and Gemini 3.x replies run slow (its thinking can't be switched off; gemini-2.5-flash is the one that truly switches off). - GPT-5.6-Luna prices updated (OpenAI's 80% July cut) - existing configs corrected automatically, hand-edited prices honored; Luna now heads the model dropdowns. - Full model guide: github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/docs/choosing-a-model.md
